import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier, RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data from correct locations
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Load sample submission if it exists (for format consistency)
sample_sub = None
if os.path.exists("./input/sample_submission_null.csv"):
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Extract and clean comments
def extract_and_clean_comment(row):
    raw = row.get("Comment", "")
    if pd.isna(raw) or str(raw).strip() == "" or isinstance(raw, float):
        return ""
    text = str(raw).replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\t", "\t").strip()
    text = text.replace('"', "").replace("\r", "").strip()
    return text


# Apply to both sets
train_clean = train.copy()
test_clean = test.copy()

train_clean["clean_text"] = train_clean.apply(extract_and_clean_comment, axis=1)
test_clean["clean_text"] = test_clean.apply(extract_and_clean_comment, axis=1)

# Filter out empty comments
train_mask = (
    train_clean["clean_text"].notna()
    & (~pd.isna(train_clean["clean_text"]))
    & (train_clean["clean_text"].astype(str).str.strip() != "")
)
test_mask = (
    test_clean["clean_text"].notna()
    & (~pd.isna(test_clean["clean_text"]))
    & (test_clean["clean_text"].astype(str).str.strip() != "")
)

train_clean = train_clean[train_mask]
test_clean = test_clean[test_mask]

# Prepare features for all data
X_train_texts = train_clean["clean_text"].tolist()
X_test_texts = test_clean["clean_text"].tolist()

# Fit vectorizers on training data only - CRITICAL FIX: use fit_transform
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=30000, ngram_range=(1, 2), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=3
)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    tokenizer=None,
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=5000,
    max_df=0.9,
    min_df=2,
)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char]).toarray()

y_train_labels = train_clean["Insult"].values.astype(int)

print(f"Label distribution:\n{np.bincount(y_train_labels)}")

# Split into train/val (80/20) with stratification for proper hold-out evaluation
X_train_arr, X_val_arr, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined,
    y_train_labels,
    test_size=0.20,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_labels,
)

print(f"Train size: {len(X_train_arr)}, Val size: {len(X_val_arr)}")

# Ensemble Hyperparameters optimized for better generalization
param_grid_lr = {"C": [0.001, 0.01, 0.1], "solver": ["lbfgs"], "max_iter": [5000]}
param_grid_gb = {
    "n_estimators": [100, 200],
    "max_depth": [3, 5, 7],
    "min_samples_leaf": [1, 2],
    "learning_rate": [0.05, 0.1],
}
param_grid_rf = {
    "n_estimators": [200, 300],
    "max_depth": [5, 10, None],
    "min_samples_split": [2, 5],
}

cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Train individual models separately
best_scores = []
models = {}

# Logistic Regression with fine-tuned search
grid_search_lr = GridSearchCV(
    LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"),
    param_grid=param_grid_lr,
    cv=cv,
    n_jobs=-1,
    scoring="roc_auc",
    verbose=0,
)
grid_search_lr.fit(X_train_arr, y_train)
lr_model = grid_search_lr.best_estimator_
best_scores.append(lr_model.score(y_val, lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_arr)[:, 1]))

# Gradient Boosting with tuned parameters
grid_search_gb = GridSearchCV(
    GradientBoostingClassifier(),
    param_grid=param_grid_gb,
    cv=cv,
    n_jobs=-1,
    scoring="roc_auc",
    verbose=0,
    error_rel_tol=1e-3,
)
grid_search_gb.fit(X_train_arr, y_train)
gb_model = grid_search_gb.best_estimator_
best_scores.append(grid_search_gb.score(y_val, gb_model.predict_proba(X_val_arr)[:, 1]))

# Random Forest with depth control
grid_search_rf = GridSearchCV(
    RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42),
    param_grid=param_grid_rf,
    cv=cv,
    n_jobs=-1,
    scoring="roc_auc",
    verbose=0,
    max_n_trees=500,
)
grid_search_rf.fit(X_train_arr, y_train)
rf_model = grid_search_rf.best_estimator_
best_scores.append(grid_search_rf.score(y_val, rf_model.predict_proba(X_val_arr)[:, 1]))

print(
    f"Best CV AUC Scores: LR={best_scores[0]:.4f}, GB={best_scores[1]:.4f}, RF={best_scores[2]:.4f}"
)

# Ensemble: average predictions from all best models
X_val_preds_ensemble = (
    lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_arr)[:, 1]
    + gb_model.predict_proba(X_val_arr)[:, 1]
    + rf_model.predict_proba(X_val_arr)[:, 1]
) / 3.0

validation_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, X_val_preds_ensemble)
print(f"AUC-ROC on held-out validation set (Ensemble): {validation_auc:.6f}")

# Test predictions on provided unlabeled data using fitted transformers
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_texts)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_texts)
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char]).toarray()

# Generate predictions from ensemble models
test_predictions = (
    lr_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
    + gb_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
    + rf_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
) / 3.0

# Clip predictions to valid range
test_predictions = np.clip(test_predictions, 0.001, 0.999)

# Create submission directory and file
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Ensure submission matches expected columns from sample
submission = pd.DataFrame({"prediction": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Validation AUC score (for reference): {validation_auc:.6f}")
